# Earth Cone Building Contracting

Earth Cone is a building construction and maintenance contractor headquartered in
Dubai, licensed to operate across all seven Emirates of the United Arab Emirates
(Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain).

## Services

- Construction — /services/construction
- Interior fit-out — /services/interiors
- Custom kitchens — /services/kitchens
- Electrical — /services/electrical
- Water systems (plumbing, tanks, pumps) — /services/water-systems
